title: Partner Co-sell Pipeline Review - Aurion Partners
next_steps: Liam to send updated co-sell pipeline spreadsheet and deck link
Priya to schedule a 1-hour technical benchmark with Marcus and Aurion infra team
Aurion to confirm list of top 5 joint accounts for Q2 motion
Schedule exec intro (Aurion VP Sales) for week of 2026-04-27
action_items: Liam Chen - Send co-sell pipeline spreadsheet and sample SOW - due 2026-04-20
Priya Nair - Run initial latency/cost baseline on Redwood Hosted vs Dedicated with Marcus - target 2026-04-23
Daniel Park - Provide contact list and contract cadence for top 5 accounts - due 2026-04-21
Marcus Lee - Share current infra diagrams and SAML metadata - due 2026-04-22
summary: Weekly partner co-sell pipeline sync between Redwood AE/SE and Aurion Channel team. Reviewed top joint deals, discussed technical blockers and co-sell coverage. Agreed next steps to run benchmarks, share pipeline spreadsheet, and schedule exec intro.
transcript:
Header: 2026-04-17 16:00 UTC | Duration: 45m | Attendees: Liam Chen (Redwood AE), Priya Nair (Redwood SE), Daniel Park (Aurion Channel Lead), Elena Ruiz (Aurion AE), Marcus Lee (Aurion SE)

[00:00] Liam: Hey folks, thanks for taking the time. Quick agenda: pipeline review, coverage, any technical blockers, and then next steps.
[00:20] Daniel: Yeah, thanks Liam. We have about 7 joint opps right now, prioritizing NexHealth, QuantumPay, and Helix.
[00:40] Elena: Quick note, two of those are motioning towards proof of value in May, so timeline's tight.
[01:10] Priya: Got it. For the ones moving fast, we should agree whether we recommend Redwood Hosted first or push Dedicated. Latency/cost tradeoffs come up.
[01:40] Marcus: On QuantumPay specifically they care about PCI and VPC peering. We need to confirm KMS integration and audit logs.
[02:05] Liam: Yes, on KMS we have HSM/KMS options in Private, and Dedicated can be in a customer VPC; I'll follow up with security docs.
[02:30] Daniel: Perfect. Also, how are we handling co-sell discounts? Aurion expects a partner margin in the SOW.
[02:55] Liam: We have a standard co-sell pricing template, but we can do a demo of the econ model. I'll share the spreadsheet after this call.
[03:20] Elena: For NexHealth, they're hung up on SOC 2 and data retention. They asked if logs can be kept for 12 months.
[03:45] Priya: SOC 2 and retention are configurable depending on plan; we can extend retention for enterprise. We'll surface specific SLAs in the security deck.
[04:10] Marcus: From a tech perspective, we'd like to run a baseline of a 2k token prompt at peak QPS to see KV cache behavior.
[04:35] Priya: That sounds reasonable. I'll put together a simple benchmark harness. We typically test 1k-4k tokens across our hosting and dedicated stacks.
[05:05] Liam: Cool. Just to orient everyone, current ARR estimates on the table: NexHealth ~140k ARR, QuantumPay ~95k, Helix ~60k, plus four smaller deals.
[05:35] Daniel: Those numbers align with our forecast. Which deals need executive coverage?
[05:50] Liam: NexHealth and QuantumPay likely. We should plan an exec intro with VP Sales and their CIO.
[06:10] Elena: Agreed. We'll loop in our SVP of Sales once we have the benchmark and SOC docs.
[06:40] Marcus: On the infra side, question about multi-region routing. Some customers want EU-only. How does Redwood handle region pinning?
[07:05] Priya: We support region pinning in the routing policy; for Hosted we route to EU regions, for Dedicated we can provision capacity in the target region. There's also fallback policies if capacity constrained.
[07:35] Marcus: Any constraints for on-prem or air-gapped? One of our prospects has strict data locality.
[07:50] Liam: We offer Private deployments and on-prem packages; that would be a different procurement path and longer timeline. We'll surface that to the customer as an option.
[08:20] Daniel: Good. On deal coverage 
dhow do we split leads and credit with Aurion?
[08:40] Liam: We typically do a co-sell agreement: partner-led with Redwood seat, or joint-led with shared credits. We'll propose a split per-deal in the spreadsheet.
[09:05] Elena: Is there a standard SLA for response times for co-sell supported deals?
[09:25] Liam: For Dedicated/Private deals we provide SLA-backed latency targets; for Hosted it's more of a best-effort with documented performance profiles.
[09:50] Marcus: Any known gotchas with SAML SSO integrations? We have customers that use Okta and on-prem ADFS.
[10:10] Priya: SAML is supported; we might need metadata exchange. A couple customers required small cert rotations, but nothing major. We'll ask Marcus to share sample metadata.
[10:40] Daniel: Competitor callouts 
these customers have also been talking to LargeCloudAI and a small infra vendor, ModelServeX. Need to make sure we differentiate on cost and production support.
[11:05] Liam: Right — emphasize our production-first runtime, cost controls (batching, caching), and unified tooling across Hosted/Dedicated/Private.
[11:30] Elena: For messaging, Aurion wants a one-pager on reliability and cost savings for customers.
[11:45] Liam: I'll draft a co-sell one-pager and the econ model.
[12:05] Marcus: For the benchmark, can we also capture token-level cost and p99 latency? Those are the metrics the SREs care about.
[12:25] Priya: Absolutely — I'll instrument for cost per 1k tokens and p50/p95/p99 latencies.
[12:50] Daniel: Timeline check — if we run benchmark next week and get SOC docs the week after, can we do an exec intro end of April?
[13:10] Liam: That seems feasible. We'll aim for the week of 2026-04-27.
[13:35] Elena: A couple of deals are in EMEA — any thoughts on EMEA commercial terms? Aurion asks about GDPR and data residency.
[13:55] Priya: We have EU region support and data residency controls; we'll include the GDPR summary in the security pack.
[14:20] Daniel: On enablement, Aurion reps asked for a 30-min training on Redwood flow and handoff. Can we do that?
[14:40] Liam: Yes, we'll schedule a partner enablement session and a one-page cheat sheet.
[15:00] Marcus: Small technical ask — is there gRPC endpoints or only REST? Some SREs prefer gRPC for streaming.
[15:20] Priya: Currently we support REST/HTTP streaming; gRPC internal roadmap is TBD but we can discuss integration patterns.
[15:45] Daniel: For QuantumPay specifically, procurement is sensitive to contract terms. Any tips for shortening legal review?
[16:05] Liam: We have a partner-friendly SOW and standard T&Cs; sharing the sample SOW early often speeds review.
[16:30] Elena: Great. On the pipeline spreadsheet, can Redwood include a field for expected partner discount and margin?
[16:50] Liam: Yes, we'll add columns: partner margin, Redwood list price, likely net.
[17:10] Marcus: If we do Dedicated for NexHealth, what's the provisioning lead time?
[17:30] Priya: Typical Dedicated provisioning is 2-4 weeks depending on capacity and region, plus any networking setup. We should flag that early.
[17:55] Daniel: Noted. Are there any outstanding legal blockers from Redwood's side for co-sell?
[18:15] Liam: Nothing special; just standard partner agreement and MSA. We'll provide templates.
[18:35] Elena: For the demo/poc, Aurion prefers a quick POC with a set eval harness. Can Redwood provide eval prompts?
[18:55] Priya: Yes, we have prompt sets and we can share a starter eval to lock quality baselines.
[19:20] Marcus: Also curious about model variants. Can we fallback to smaller models if costs spike?
[19:40] Priya: We support automated fallback to compatible variants and quantized profiles to manage costs. We'll show the recommendation engine in the console.
[20:05] Liam: Let's walk the top five accounts on the spreadsheet now — quick cadence. (sound of typing)
[20:35] Elena: NexHealth: stage - PoV, close target 2026-05-15, ARR est 140k, Need: SOC2, 12mo logs, low latency. Owner: Aurion AE.
[21:05] Liam: QuantumPay: stage - evaluation, close target 2026-05-30, ARR est 95k, Need: PCI considerations, VPC peering, KMS. Owner: Aurion SE.
[21:40] Marcus: Helix: stage - early engagement, close target 2026-06-20, ARR est 60k, Need: multi-region and E2E encryption.
[22:05] Liam: Smaller deals (four) sum to ~80k, mostly mid-market, quick closes.
[22:30] Daniel: Any blockers on Redwood's side to prioritizing capacity for NexHealth?
[22:50] Priya: If it's Dedicated, we can prioritize but need a signed commit; Hosted can be used as a stopgap.
[23:10] Elena: For procurement, Aurion will need estimated MRC and one-time setup fees in the SOW.
[23:30] Liam: We'll include those in the spreadsheet and sample SOW.
[23:50] Marcus: Can Redwood expose audit logs to Aurion's SIEM?
[24:10] Priya: Yes, we have log shipping options and syslog integration for enterprise plans.
[24:30] Daniel: Ok, anything else on technical risks?
[24:50] Marcus: Just the typical: cert rotations, SAML metadata exchange, and some customers wanting on-prem-only.
[25:10] Liam: We'll put mitigation notes for each in the pipeline doc.
[25:30] Elena: On co-sell ops, Aurion wants a regular weekly sync. Is that ok?
[25:50] Liam: Yes, weekly cadence works. We'll keep it to 30 mins after initial exec steps.
[26:10] Daniel: Should we do a joint EBC for NexHealth?
[26:30] Liam: Yes — plan an EBC after benchmark results and when SOC docs are shared.
[26:50] Marcus: One more tech note — caching behavior for repeated prompts. Can Redwood share TTL and cache invalidation policies?
[27:10] Priya: We'll include a short doc on prefix/KV caching and recommended TTLs by workload.
[27:35] Elena: Any updates on partner incentives for Q2? Aurion asks for bonus for first closed joint deal.
[27:55] Liam: We can discuss a limited-time incentive for Q2 when we finalize partner agreement. I'll propose options.
[28:20] Daniel: Good. For the benchmark harness, who will own running it on the Aurion side?
[28:40] Marcus: I'll coordinate with my infra team and work with Priya on credentials.
[29:00] Priya: I'll send a short runbook and a test harness repo link.
[29:20] Liam: Ok quick recap of owners and dates before we wrap.
[29:35] Liam: Action 1: Liam sends spreadsheet and SOW (due 2026-04-20). Action 2: Priya runs benchmark (target 2026-04-23). Action 3: Marcus shares SAML metadata and infra diagrams (due 2026-04-22). Action 4: Daniel to confirm top 5 accounts (due 2026-04-21).
[30:10] Elena: We'll confirm exec intro once benchmark and SOC docs look good.
[30:30] Liam: Any final questions?
[30:45] Daniel: Not from me. Thanks everyone.
[31:00] Marcus: One tiny ask — can Redwood provide a short CTAs doc for Aurion reps?
[31:20] Liam: Yes, we'll provide a cheat sheet and one-pager.
[31:40] Elena: Great, thanks.
[31:55] Priya: I'll follow up with the runbook and schedule the benchmark slot.
[32:10] Liam: Thanks all. We'll follow up via email with links: deck, security pack, and the pipeline spreadsheet.
[32:30] Daniel: Thanks. Talk soon.
[32:45] (call ends)
